segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To meet.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Gặp.] [EN: I feel happy.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi thấy vui.] [EN: No way, not at all.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Đâu có!] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Thử.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: To try on.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: After you try clothes on, you describe the fit. Tight is] [VI_F: Chật.] [EN: a falling, broken tone. This shirt is tight.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Áo này chật.] [EN: Loose, or roomy, is] [VI_F: Rộng.] [EN: a falling, broken tone; relax your lips. It fits, or it's just right, is] [VI_F: Vừa.] [EN: a falling tone; relax your lips for this vowel. It fits well.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Vừa lắm.] [EN: Good. Do you have a bigger one? It's a bit tight.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Có cái lớn hơn không? Hơi chật.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Tight.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Chật.] [EN: Loose.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Rộng.] [EN: It fits.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Vừa.] [EN: This shirt is tight.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Áo này chật.] [EN: It's a bit loose.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Hơi rộng.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Vừa.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: It fits, just right.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Rộng.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Loose, roomy.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Áo vừa không anh?] [VI_M: Hơi chật. Có cái lớn hơn không?] [VI_F: Dạ có, anh thử cái này.] [VI_M: À, cái này vừa.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say, this shirt is tight.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Áo này chật.] [EN: Say, it fits well.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Vừa lắm.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you compare things. The preview word is] [VI: giống] [EN: which means the same, alike.]
